name: Thaw
tagline: Scores invented water pipes for one-year failure risk, explained in plain words
description: Sketch a water pipe or hand over a CSV, and a random-forest model trained purely on synthetic data rates the odds of a failure within the year, then explains the score in plain English. Every pipe is invented, so this demonstrates AI-assisted asset planning rather than watching real infrastructure.
author: thebytorsnowdog
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
